2026-07-01: Source-reviewed Apple container 1.0.0-34-g9bd3c47 (the latest clone) to settle whether the non-root SSH-agent-socket permission blocker is fixed. It is NOT: RuntimeService.swift ~1034-1046 copies only the host socket's POSIX mode bits onto a root-owned guest relay socket and never chowns it to the non-root guest user; upstream commit 888582b (#1751) confirms this because its own regression test must force the host socket to 0766 (world-writable) for a non-root guest to connect. A normal 0600/0700 agent socket therefore remains permission-denied for RunHaven's agent user.
